scope: Hash-pinned A1 finite-cutoff production Gaussian on L=16, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the common real-even scalar A7 regulator class. The smart-path identities hold at every finite cutoff and pass continuously to both endpoints. The frozen-shell theorem permits an arbitrary past-measurable PSD spatial background and arbitrary past-measurable derivative source. The theorem does not bound the final commutator under the tilted interacting laws.

theorem.smart_path: For independent standard white noises x,y, z_s=s*x+sqrt(1-s^2)*y, T(x)=G^*M_B(Kx)G>=0, and H_s=U(Kx)+(z_s^T T(x) z_s-Tr T(x))/2, Phi_Lambda(s)=log E exp(-p H_s) has the exact finite-cutoff Gaussian covariance derivative recorded in the proof note.
theorem.conditional_determinant: With t=1-s^2, R_t=(I+p*t*T)^(-1), and S_t=T*R_t, integrating y gives W_t=-pU-(1/2)log det_2(I+p*t*T)+p(1-t)[Tr T-x^T S_t x]/2.
theorem.cancelled_derivative: Gaussian integration by parts yields d_t Phi=(p/2) E_nu[-p<DU,S_t x>+<a_t,S_t x>+<div S_t,x>], where a_t is the explicit DB term. The apparent positive ||S_t x||^2 term cancels exactly.
theorem.trace_reduction: Tr T_i-x^T R_t T_i R_t x=Tr[(I-R_t^2)T_i]-{x^T R_t T_i R_t x-Tr(R_t T_i R_t)}. Since I-R_t^2=p*t*S_t(I+R_t), only Schatten-2 pairings and centered Hilbert-Schmidt quadratics remain.
theorem.common_even_divergence: The exact same-point identity D_x C_Lambda(x,y)|_(y=x)=0 gives div T=0 and div S_t=-p*t contraction_i(S_t T_i R_t), hence ||div S_t||<=p*t||S_t||_S2(sum_i||T_i||_S2^2)^(1/2).
theorem.physical_derivative_bound: At fixed positive rho floor, B is C-infinity with quadratic growth and DB has linear growth. A8's trace-ideal bound and trace-class value covariance imply a cutoff-uniform bound on sum_i||T_i||_S2^2 by a constant times int(1+|X|)^2.
theorem.noncentral_frozen_shell: For A=M_b^(1/2)G_j, T=A^*A, q=M_b^(1/2)a, and Q=(||q+A xi_j||^2-Tr T)/2, log E exp(-pQ) equals [pTrT-log det(I+pT)]/2-p||q||^2/2+p^2<A^*q,(I+pT)^(-1)A^*q>/2 and is at most p^2||T||_S2^2/4.
theorem.entropy_form: For every conditional law nu_j and eta>0, E_nu Q>=-eta H(nu_j|gamma_j)-||T||_S2^2/(4eta).
theorem.dyadic_gain: For a q^-4 covariance and a dyadic annulus j, ||T_j,b||_S2^2<=C_sh(L) M_R^4 c_symbol^(-2) 2^(-j)||b||_L2^2. Thus the frozen-shell determinant costs are summable and are quartic in the coefficient field.
theorem.independent_shift: For every deterministic Cameron-Martin shift h, or h independent of X_Lambda, E V_Lambda^ren(X_Lambda+h)=(1/2)sum_i int E[(D_i h)^T B(X_Lambda+h)D_i h]>=0. Only genuine same-noise adapted dependence can create the unresolved negative contribution.

remaining_commutator.sufficient_bound: For every eta>0, uniformly in cutoff J and every tilted law nu, E_nu sum_(j<=J) C_j>=-eta H(nu|gamma_J)-eta E_nu||phi_J||_6^6-C_eta.
remaining_commutator.smart_path_equivalent_target: It is also sufficient to bound the negative variation of the exact cancelled derivative uniformly in Lambda over t in [0,1].
remaining_commutator.status: OPEN. Unshifted Gaussian L2/shell summability is known but does not imply the all-tilted-laws entropy form bound.
